description_en: Queries the domain names that are deleted from your account
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnDeletedDomains查询您名下已删除的域名
name: DescribeCdnDeletedDomains

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Valid values: 1 to 100000. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码，默认值1，取值范围：1~100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of domain names to return per page. Valid values: an integer between 1 and 500. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的域名个数，默认值20，取值范围：1~500之前的任意整数
parameters.name: page_size

PageData.description_en: The list of accelerated domain names and the time each domain name was last modified

items.description_en: The information about the accelerated domain name

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the accelerated domain name was modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
GmtModified.description_zh: 加速域名修改时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page, which is the same as the PageNumber parameter in request parameters
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of domain names returned per page, which is the same as the PageSize parameter in request parameters
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的域名个数，同请求参数的PageSize

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of domain names returned
